name: cloudlab-monorepo
description: CloudLab — Interactive & Intelligent Cloud/DevOps Training Platform (Express.js Edition)

scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,LEARN,PROGRESS,PROJECT,COMM" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,green,white,bgBlue" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:learning" "npm run dev:progress" "npm run dev:project" "npm run dev:communication"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,LEARN,PROGRESS,PROJECT,COMM,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,green,white,bgBlue,red" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:learning" "npm run dev:progress" "npm run dev:project" "npm run dev:communication" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist
